protocol.purpose: Diagnose probability, gradient and deployment changes when extending the frozen v8 controller update; no test-set claim.

probe.scope: Frozen observations from training roots only; no gradient or rollout influence.

protocol.pairing: Learner batches use frozen v8 root/task-local generators. Policy draws use a fresh generator keyed by dev root, draw, task and local step, shared across checkpoints, policy seeds and arms.
protocol.evaluation: Every checkpoint receives greedy and three stochastic rollouts on every development root. Average draws then policy seeds within each root; four roots remain the replication unit. Retain all failures and report monitor reach, independent diagonal/final reach, positive forgetting, accuracy and costs.
interpretation: No material probability/action change: deployment remains effectively initial under this protocol.
Policy changes without consistent development benefit: optimization moved the policy but did not validate its utility.
Consistent paired development changes: development signal only, requiring a separately designed future evaluation.
constraints: Load official CIFAR-100 train only; never official test or audit-class images.
Same v8 dev class pool with fresh roots; not new categories or confirmatory evidence.
Do not extend rounds or add candidates after viewing outcomes.
global_0 means zero expert weight displacement while moments advance; stem and heads still train.
Checkpoints share one training prefix per arm/seed; training is not repeated for each budget.
No significance or non-inferiority claim from this diagnostic grid.

total_cost.note: Physical learner work. Shared training prefixes are charged once per GRPO group; each dev rollout is run and charged independently. audit_examples is the inherited endpoint-evaluation counter and contains train-split dev images only. Not FLOPs matched.

unit_of_summary: root; sample draws, then learned policy seeds, are averaged inside root before cross-root summaries
interpretation: development-only diagnostic; no confirmation, win, or non-inferiority claim
